messages:
jen_support: FYI — customer Acme (acct acme-corp) reporting serious change in invoice extractor after canary this morning. They say removing a single space in their prompt template now drops most line items. Happening for multiple invoices. Started ~09:12 PST.

alex_eng: Can you paste the exact prompt payload and the API response they got? Also which model variant/commit?

jen_support: Here's the user's template (they only changed spacing between the list and total):
```
PROMPT_TEMPLATE_V1 (working before):

Invoice:
{{#items}}
- {{name}}: {{amount}}
{{/items}}

Total: {{total}}

PROMPT_TEMPLATE_V2 (repro):

Invoice:
{{#items}}
- {{name}}: {{amount}}
{{/items}}

Total:{{total}}  <-- note: no space after colon
```

jen_support: API response they pasted (trimmed):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-infer-v2.1",
  "output": "Invoice:\n- Service fee\nTotal:\n"
}
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: commit abcdef1 -> v2.1 rolled to 20% @2026-03-15T09:05:00Z; increased to 40% @2026-03-15T09:20:00Z.

kia_sre: @alex_eng please check tokenization/whitespace trimming changes in the latest runtime commit — we had a small change to trim trailing tokens around punctuation for some quantization paths. Could cause boundary shifts.

alex_eng: Running quick A/B now. Repro steps I used (curl):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-infer-v2.1","prompt":"<user template with no-space Total:{{total}}>","max_tokens":200}'
```

alex_eng: Results: pinned older model (redwood-infer-v2.0-2026-03-10) returns full item list. v2.1 drops items and returns early EOS in several cases. Repro rate ~85% for templates where colon is immediately adjacent to token.

sam_product: We shipped a tokenizer normalization tweak and a KV cache alignment change to reduce memory. Both could alter token boundaries for punctuation-adjacent substrings — makes sense this would be sensitive.

jen_support: Customer impact: multiple invoices dropped, they tried 5 examples and 4 failed after canary. They're on Dedicated but using hosted model catalog pointer (auto-upgrade). Want immediate mitigation.

alex_eng: Short-term mitigation: route Acme to redwood-infer-v2.0 (pre-rollout) and roll back the canary step for v2.1 while we root cause. I'll open an infra rollback ticket and a customer routing override.

kia_sre: I'll add a hotfix flag to disable the tokenizer normalization on the canary path and re-run smoke. Could be low risk.

deploy-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-2489 — "Template whitespace sensitivity after v2.1 canary". Assigned to eng-runtime (alex_eng) and eng-infra (kia_sre).

alex_eng: Quick triage notes: suspect tokenizer normalization + quantized kernel ordering -> token boundary shift -> generation sees immediate EOS token after Total: in some cases. Repro script attached to ticket.

sam_product: We'll also add prompt-sensitivity tests to the rollout gating matrix (small whitespace diffs + colon adjacent cases). Add Acme's examples as a regression test.

jen_support: Customer notified we can route them to v2.0 immediately and investigating. They asked for ETA on fix; I'll tell them ~4-8 hrs for mitigation and more for full fix.

alex_eng: Plan: 1) temporary routing override for Acme (done) 2) disable token normalization on canary 3) run 1k-sample regression harness with patched runtime 4) targeted fix and safe canary re-release.

jen_support: Thanks — please paste the ticket link when available and I'll update the customer thread. :thumbsup:

sam_product: Noting for release notes: "Tokenizer normalization may affect templates with punctuation-adjacent variables; reverted on canary pending fix."

jen_support: Closing loop here when rollback/pin is confirmed. Current status: Acme routed to v2.0, canary paused at 40%.

alex_eng: Will follow up with logs and the exact commit diff in INC-2026-2489.

jen_support: Adding customer quote to ticket: "We only removed a single space and it nuked our invoice lines — urgent."

kia_sre: :eyes: monitoring alerts enabled for related generation error spike.

jen_support: (closing note) Recommend support playbook update: if customer reports missing structured lines after deploy, try whitespace variants and route to prior model version.
